name: Sliplane

evidence.paas: 03: managed container platform; Sliplane runs the hosts, builds and deployments

line: Deploy container apps and PostgreSQL on managed servers.

free.text: 48-hour demo, no card, up to twice; data is deleted at expiry

cells.regions: DE, FI, US East/West, SG; Confidential needs agreement

work.math: €9 a month before VAT. Includes 100 build minutes and 100 GB of data sent out, within the 1 TB fair-use level. Assumes file and server use fit 20 GB. Capacity is untested.
The fixed monthly price is €17.80 before VAT. Hourly billing for 730 whole hours is €22.24967. The base has 2 shared vCPU and 2 GB. 100 GB of traffic and builds fit fair use.

work.plan: Shared Base + PG Base + daily backups
work.math: €17.80 for the app + €24.70 for a PG Base database = €42.50 a month before VAT. 7-day point-in-time recovery (PITR) and 10 GB same-region traffic are included. Daily portable dumps need SimpleBackups Plus at $99 a month.
